we propose to learn a set of learn- able meta class memory embeddings to memorizing the meta class information and transfer to novel class inference.
we propose a novel method to learn meta class information for few shot semantic segmentation.

we propose a novel method to learn meta class information in the few shot segmentation task by introducing a set of learn-able memory embeddings and a novel image quality measure to select support images.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following two problems.
the problem of learning meta class representations in a few shot segmentation setting, which is a new direction of few shot segmentation research.
the problem of few-shot semantic segmentation, which is the task of segmenting a novel class from a set of images with only a small number of labeled examples.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed method outperforms all the existing state of the art few shot segmentation methods in both 1 shot and 5 shot setting on both PASCal and COCO datasets.

our proposed method achieves state of the art performance on both 1shot (37.5%) and 5shot (46.4%) setting on COCO dataset, which is 4.7% and 3.6% higher than the current state of the art respectively.
we propose a novel meta class memory based few shot semantic segmentation network (MM Net), where we introduce a learnable meta class memory for the network to learn meta class representations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we introduce the concept meta class memory to learn the meta information shareable across classes in few shot semantic segmentation.
we propose a new method to learn meta class representations, which is able to improve the performance for few shot semantic segmentation.

our proposed meta class memory network can be used to learn the class specific information as well as the meta class information in few shot setting and can be used as a plug-in to existing few shot semantic segmentation methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
meta class is a key to improve few shot semantic segmentation.
, by explicitly modeling meta class information, the few shot segmentation task can be better solved.
the meta information is important in few shot segmentation tasks, and the meta information could be effectively memorized and transferred to novel classes with our proposed MMNet.
